changelog: **Deployment-specific hosts and app ids come from configuration, not code (#2926).** `MARKETING_HOSTS` has no built-in default any more: unset or empty means no host serves the marketing product (`src/lib/servedHosts.ts`; `primaryMarketingHost()` returns `null`, `originForWorld('MARKETING')` then stays on the internship origin). The served Digital Asset Links come from the server env `ANDROID_APP_LINKS` (JSON keyed by vertical, validated, forwarded by `infra/deploy-prod.sh`); unset serves `[]` as before. The TWA package id comes from `TWA_PACKAGE_ID` at build time (a release build under the `com.example.*` placeholder is refused), and the Expo app reads `EXPO_OWNER`, `APP_BUNDLE_ID`, `APP_ANDROID_PACKAGE` and the build-time product list `EXPO_PUBLIC_EXTRA_PRODUCTS` (an EAS build without the publisher ids fails closed). The deploy workflows pass the marketing probe host from the `MARKETING_PROBE_HOST_PROD` / `MARKETING_PROBE_HOST_PREVIEW` secrets. Tests, e2e helpers (`e2e/helpers/marketingHost.ts`, set as `MARKETING_HOSTS` by `playwright.config.ts`) and seeds use synthetic hosts and company names; the seed adds its sample companies only to a database without any.
